scope: Source-faithful extraction of recorded candidate construction; no outcomes or experiment results changed.

pusht-confirmation.adaptation: Public names and validation; retention omits an outcome-pair branch whose two members are already in the retained top 16. Resulting IDs are unchanged.

reference-control.adaptation: Extract per-family RNG draws, source-dtype deduplication and ID order from the recorded control builder.

visual-shape.adaptation: Preserve pixel normalization, whole-bank seed retries and float16-to-float32 quantization.

granular.adaptation: Retain transformation arithmetic, ID order, difficulty multipliers and the immutable hash namespace; omit simulator/publication bookkeeping.

verification.comparison: Exact array equality against original functions over three seeds, two control dtypes, three Granular tiers and three replay offsets; PushT retention additionally compared under three different label patterns.
